title: QuickJS-NG before 0.16.0 contains an integer overflow in js_proxy_get_own_property_names() in quickjs.c that causes a…
description: QuickJS-NG versions before 0.16.0 have an integer overflow vulnerability in the js_proxy_get_own_property_names() function within quickjs.c. This flaw can lead to a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit systems when JavaScript code returns a large array-like object from a Proxy ownKeys trap. The vulnerability may cause application crashes or potentially allow code execution.
